name: api_health
title: Check liveness
description: Whether the service is up. It touches nothing, so it answers even while a backend is down.

name: api_status
title: Check readiness
description: Whether the service is ready, and every provider's verdict: its name, whether a ready service needs it, whether it answers, how long it took (ms) and why not. Ready means every required provider answers.

name: doc_convert
title: Convert a document to Markdown
description: Any document (PDF, Office, HTML, images, EPUB…) under the vault or the workspaces, by `path`, read into Markdown: tables as tables, scans read, pages in order. No model reads it — the engines do. Returns `name` and `markdown`.

name: doc_inspect
title: Inspect a PDF
description: A PDF by `path`: each page's size in points (origin bottom-left), its metadata and every form field — full name, kind, page, rectangle, value. Read this before doc_fill; it never returns the PDF's text.

name: doc_merge
title: Merge PDFs
description: Two or more PDFs by `paths`, joined in that order into one; `name` is its stem. Returns its `path`.

name: doc_split
title: Split a PDF
description: A PDF by `path`, cut into `ranges` — `[first, last]` page pairs counted from 0, both included — one PDF each. Returns their paths.

name: doc_fill
title: Fill a PDF form
description: A PDF form by `path`, its fields set from `values` (full field name → value; a checkbox takes true/false), as doc_inspect names them; an unknown name refuses the fill. Returns the filled copy's `path`.

name: doc_render
title: Render PDF pages
description: A PDF by `path`, its `pages` (from 0; all when empty) drawn as PNG at `dpi` (36-600, default 110). Returns the images' paths.

name: doc_stamp
title: Stamp a PDF
description: An `image` (a PNG path, its transparency kept) or a `text` drawn on a PDF by `path`, `at` a form field, a text anchor or a box (PDF points, bottom-left origin). The image keeps its aspect ratio. Returns the copy's `path`.

name: doc_signature
title: Sign a PDF with a photo
description: A photo of a handwritten signature (`photo`) cut out and placed on a PDF (`path`) `at` as doc_stamp's. Visual only, not a cryptographic signature. Returns the copy's `path`.

name: image_cutout
title: Cut ink out of a photo
description: A photo of ink on paper (a signature) by `path`, as a transparent PNG of the ink alone: paper tint, uneven light and shadows gone, soft edges. `color` keeps the ink's own colour (default; off, black); `crop` cuts to the ink (default). Returns the PNG's `path`, the next tool's input (doc_stamp).

name: organon_find
title: Find a tool
description: The tools that answer a need, best first (at most 5): `query` in words, `section` (doc, tekton…) to narrow. Each comes with its description and its arguments' JSON Schema.

name: organon_job
title: Check a job
description: A job — a tool run in the background — by `job`: its `state` (available, running, completed, failed, cancelled), its `progress` (`steps` entered so far; at the end `done`, the tool's answer, or `failed`) and its `errors`. `wait`: seconds to hold the answer until it settles (0-25; 0 answers at once).

name: organon_cancel
title: Cancel a job
description: A job by `job`, stopped where it awaits; one already settled comes back as it is.

name: tekton_eng
title: Run an eng order
description: Pass the user's `eng` message exactly as typed, prefix included; the grammar is parsed here, never by you. `project`: the project the conversation is about, for an order that names none; `profile`: what a new run may do. Grammar: `eng [project:] <order>` new session · `eng @ref: <order>` continue · `eng @ref+: <order>` branch · `eng @ref?` where it stopped · `eng @ref = <title>` rename · `eng ls [project]` sessions · `eng ps` tasks · `eng stop <task>`. `ref` is a session id, its first 8 characters or its exact title. Answers `verb` and `result`.

name: tekton_start
title: Start work in Claude Code
description: Run a prompt in Claude Code on this machine, with the user's whole setup (CLAUDE.md, skills, commands, agents, hooks). Returns at once with `id` (the task) and, once known, `session`. `prompt`: plain words, or a command/skill such as "/research vLLM sleep mode" (see tekton_catalog). `project`: a short name ("e-voice") or a path. `profile`: what the run may do — the profiles are the service's book (profiles.yaml): `code` by default, a refusal lists the declared ones. `session`: continue that conversation instead of starting one (its id, the first 8 characters of it, or its exact title); `fork`: branch it. Next: tekton_status with `id`; keep `session` to continue later.

name: tekton_status
title: Check a task
description: A task's state (running, done, failed, cancelled), its session, final `result`, `error`, cost and turns. `wait` (seconds, at most 25) returns as soon as it ends instead of right away.

name: tekton_tasks
title: List tasks
description: The newest tasks first — what is running, what finished; `state` narrows to one state.

name: tekton_cancel
title: Cancel a task
description: Interrupt a running task; a finished one comes back unchanged. Its session can be continued.

name: tekton_catalog
title: What Claude Code offers in a project
description: The slash commands, skills and agents Claude Code has in `project` (short name or path; empty means the workspace root). Use a command or skill as a tekton_start prompt: "/<name> <arguments>".

name: tekton_find
title: Find Claude Code sessions
description: Recorded sessions, newest first: id, title, project, branch, tag, last change. `project` narrows to one project (short name or path), `text` to titles, branches or tags that contain it. Next: tekton_read to see where one stopped, tekton_start with `session` to continue it.

name: tekton_read
title: Read where a session stopped
description: A session and its last `last` turns, oldest first: what the user asked, what Claude Code answered, which tools it called. `session`: its id, the first 8 characters of it, or its exact title. Read it before continuing a session with tekton_start.

name: tekton_update
title: Rename or tag a session
description: Give a session a `title` and/or a `tag` (an empty tag clears it); returns the session.

name: tekton_peers
title: List open Claude Code sessions
description: The sessions open in a terminal right now: name, kind, idle or busy. tekton_send reaches one.

name: tekton_send
title: Message an open session
description: Deliver `text` to an open session by its name (see tekton_peers); it reads it at its next step. Returns whether it was delivered, not what the session answers.

name: organon_submit
title: Run a tool as a job
description: A tool run in the background: `tool` is its name as `organon_find` lists it with a slash (`doc/convert`), `input` its arguments. Answers at once with the `job` to follow with organon_job; the input is checked first, a tool that is no job (tekton, organon) refused.

name: doc_ocr
title: Read a scan
description: The words of a scanned PDF or an image by `path` (`pages` from 0, all when empty; `dpi` a PDF page is drawn at, 72-300, default 150), each with its box `[left, bottom, right, top]` in points on the displayed page, origin bottom-left — where doc_stamp places things —, and each page's `text`. An image is one page, a pixel a point.
